import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected_head = "d6114a1564542b17309f91423d533345c8056307"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True, check=check, env=env)

head = run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch = run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
if head != expected_head or branch != "feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected worktree state head={head} branch={branch}")

test = wt / "tests/test_operator_progress.py"
text = test.read_text()
text = text.replace('"prior-1"', '"prior-001"')
text = text.replace('"prior-2"', '"prior-002"')
test.write_text(text)

env = os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(wt / "src")

compile_run = run([
    "python3","-m","py_compile",
    "src/do_again/core/schema.py",
    "src/do_again/core/agent.py",
    "tests/test_operator_progress.py",
], env=env)
print("py_compile=ok")

focused = run([
    "python3","-m","unittest",
    "tests.test_operator_progress",
    "tests.test_request_fingerprints",
], check=False, env=env)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print(f"focused_rc={focused.returncode}")
if focused.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

run(["git","add",
     "src/do_again/core/schema.py",
     "src/do_again/core/agent.py",
     "tests/test_operator_progress.py"])
commit = run(["git","commit","-m","Track operator acknowledgement and goal progress"], check=False)
print("=== commit stdout ===")
print(commit.stdout)
print("=== commit stderr ===")
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)

print("new_head=" + run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after=" + repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
